shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && echo "---PACKAGE---" && cat /workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null
ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__/ && echo "---" && cat /workspace/opencode.json && echo "---GITIGNORE---" && cat /workspace/.gitignore

node -e "const c=require('next/cache'); console.log('cache:', Object.keys(c).filter(k=>/revalid|unstable_cache|after/i.test(k)));" 2>/dev/null; node -e "const s=require('next/server'); console.log('server:', Object.keys(s).filter(k=>/revalid|after/i.test(k)));" 2>/dev/null

grep -rn "export.*function after\|export declare function after\|after:" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/after/*.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "after" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---types.d.ts---"; grep -rn "after" /workspace/node_modules/next/types/global.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/@edge-runtime/*/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "export.*\bafter\b" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "===search all==="; grep -rln "after" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "after" /workspace/node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "---find server entry---"; grep -rln "from './dist/server/after'" /workspace/node_modules/next 2>/dev/null | head
grep -rn "revalidateTag" /workspace/node_modules/next/cache.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -i "declare\|function\|export" | head
grep -rn "revalidateTag" /workspace/node_modules/next/cache.d.ts; echo "===global==="; grep -rn "function revalidateTag\|revalidateTag:" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | head

node -e "const c=require('next/cache'); console.log('cache keys:', Object.keys(c));" 2>/dev/null; echo "=== updateTag export search ==="; grep -rn "updateTag" /workspace/node_modules/next/cache.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== max profile ==="; grep -rn "max:" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/*.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

sed -n '1,60p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts 2>/dev/null || grep -rn "revalidateTag\|updateTag\|CacheLifeConfig" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts 2>/dev/null
find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist -name "after.js" -path "*after*" | head; echo "=== impl ==="; sed -n '1,120p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after.js 2>/dev/null

grep -rln "afterContext\|AfterContext\|class.*After" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/ 2>/async-storage.js" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== find after context impl ==="; grep -rln "after(task" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/ 2>/dev/null | head
grep -rln "after(task" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/ 2>/dev/null | head
grep -n "run\|workAsyncStorage\|getStore\|workUnitStore\|function after\|after(" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after-context.js 2>/dev/null | head -40
grep -n "validateAndNormalizeCacheLifeProfile\|expire\|throw" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/cache-life-profile.js 2>/dev/null | head -40
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
cd /workspace && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
cd /workspace && (PORT=3111 npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && echo "started" && tail -5 /tmp/next-start.log

cd /workspace && curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -o /tmp/page1.html && echo "=== product rows (stock) ===" && grep -oE '[0-9]+' /tmp/page1.html | head && echo "=== action id hidden inputs ===" && grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID[_0-9]*" value="[^"]*"|name="\$ACTION[^"]*"[^>]*' /tmp/page1.html | head && echo "=== any Next-Action refs ===" && grep -oE 'next-action[^"]*"\s*:[^,}]*|"id":"[^"]*"' /tmp/page1.html | head

cd /workspace && grep -oE '<form[^>]*>|<input[^>]*>|name="\$ACTION[^"]*"' /tmp/page1.html | head -20; echo "=== table body snippet ==="; grep -oE 'Laptop|Phone|Tablet|Headphones|Watch|>12<|>30<|>0<|>54<|>7<' /tmp/page1.html | head -20

cd /workspace && ACTION_FIELD=$(grep -oE 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-z0-9]+"' /tmp/page1.html | head -1 | sed -E 's/name="([^"]+)"/\1/') && echo "Action field: $ACTION_FIELD" && echo "--- POSTing form (triggers inline server action) ---" && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3111/ -F "$ACTION_FIELD=" -o /tmp/post_resp.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" && echo "--- immediately re-GET (should still be stale: 12/30/0/54/7) ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -o /tmp/page2.html && grep -oE 'Laptop|Phone|Tablet|Headphones|Watch' /tmp/page2.html | head -5 && grep -oE '>[0-9]+<' /tmp/page2.html | head -5

cd /workspace && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3111/ -F '$ACTION_ID_00032f6c36422de81198953bd537bfd1d624c59eb9=' -o /dev/null -w "POST#2: HTTP %{http_code} (responsive, background sync started)\n" && echo "immediate GET (expect stale 11/29/0/53/6):" && curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -o /tmp/p_imm.html && node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const h=fs.readFileSync("/tmp/p_imm.html","utf8");const t=h.slice(h.indexOf("<tbody>"),h.indexOf("</tbody>"));[...t.matchAll(/<tr>([\s\S]*?)<\/tr>/g)].map(m=>m[1]).forEach(tr=>{const c=[...tr.matchAll(/<td[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/td>/g)].map(m=>m[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g,"").trim());console.log("  "+c[1].padEnd(12),"stock="+c[3]);});' && sleep 4 && echo "GET after bg sync#2 (expect fresh 10/28/0/52/5):" && curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -o /tmp/p_after2.html && node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const h=fs.readFileSync("/tmp/p_after2.html","utf8");const t=h.slice(h.indexOf("<tbody>"),h.indexOf("</tbody>"));[...t.matchAll(/<tr>([\s\S]*?)<\/tr>/g)].map(m=>m[1]).forEach(tr=>{const c=[...tr.matchAll(/<td[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/td>/g)].map(m=>m[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g,"").trim());console.log("  "+c[1].padEnd(12),"stock="+c[3]);});'
cd /workspace && (pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null); sleep 1; echo "server stopped"
